answer: Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 6 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. Because the rationale is hashed into the ridge record and indexed in the copper history, the yarrow audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 68 aliases thus needs 68 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
